title: Physics
description: How the universe works, from projectiles and circuits to fields, waves and the nucleus. Five themes, built around the 2025 syllabus.

topics.title: Kinematics
topics.summary: Describing motion with displacement, velocity and acceleration, the equations of uniform acceleration, and projectiles.

topics.title: Forces and momentum
topics.summary: Newton’s three laws, free-body diagrams, momentum and impulse, and circular motion.

topics.title: Work, energy and power
topics.summary: Work as energy transfer, kinetic and potential energy, conservation of energy, power and efficiency.

topics.title: Rigid body mechanics
topics.summary: Torque, rotational equilibrium, moment of inertia and angular momentum.

topics.title: Galilean and special relativity
topics.summary: Reference frames, the postulates of special relativity, time dilation, length contraction and spacetime diagrams.

topics.title: Thermal energy transfers
topics.summary: Temperature, internal energy, specific heat capacity, latent heat and the mechanisms of heat transfer.

topics.title: The greenhouse effect
topics.summary: Black-body radiation, albedo, emissivity and the energy balance of the Earth.

topics.title: The gas laws
topics.summary: Pressure, the ideal gas law and the kinetic model of an ideal gas.

topics.title: Thermodynamics
topics.summary: The first and second laws, entropy, and heat engines.

topics.title: Current and circuits
topics.summary: Current, potential difference, resistance, resistivity, internal resistance and circuit analysis.

topics.title: Simple harmonic motion
topics.summary: Oscillations with a restoring force proportional to displacement, and their energy.

topics.title: The wave model
topics.summary: Transverse and longitudinal waves, the wave equation and the electromagnetic spectrum.

topics.title: Wave phenomena
topics.summary: Reflection, refraction, diffraction, superposition and interference.

topics.title: Standing waves and resonance
topics.summary: Nodes and antinodes, harmonics on strings and in pipes, resonance and damping.

topics.title: The Doppler effect
topics.summary: Frequency shifts from moving sources and observers, for light and sound.

topics.title: Gravitation
topics.summary: Newton’s law of gravitation, field strength, orbits and gravitational potential.

topics.title: Electric and magnetic fields
topics.summary: Coulomb’s law, electric field strength, magnetic fields of currents and electric potential.

topics.title: Motion in electric and magnetic fields
topics.summary: Charged particles in uniform fields and the force on a current-carrying wire.

topics.title: Electromagnetic induction
topics.summary: Magnetic flux, Faraday’s and Lenz’s laws and generators.

topics.title: Atomic physics
topics.summary: The nuclear model, energy levels and atomic spectra.

topics.title: Quantum physics
topics.summary: The photoelectric effect, wave–particle duality and Compton scattering.

topics.title: Radioactive decay
topics.summary: Nuclear stability, binding energy, decay modes and half-life.

topics.title: Nuclear fission
topics.summary: Chain reactions, the components of a reactor and its safety.

topics.title: Fusion and stars
topics.summary: Stellar equilibrium, fusion, the Hertzsprung–Russell diagram and stellar evolution.

topics.title: Experimental techniques
topics.summary: Measuring variables, safety, and choosing and using apparatus in practical work.

topics.title: Technology
topics.summary: Sensors, data logging, spreadsheets and simulations in physics investigations.

topics.title: Mathematics
topics.summary: Units and prefixes, uncertainties and errors, graphs, and scalars and vectors.
